title: verdict line, v1
description: One line of corpus mode output: the verdict a verifier reached on one corpus member, in a shape several verifiers share so their lines over the same corpus can be compared member by member. A member the verifier does not answer is stated as not-applicable, never left out, so the lines always cover the whole manifest and never read as a pass.

suite.description: The suite named by the corpus manifest.

vector.description: The id of the manifest entry the line answers.

verdict.description: The suite's verdict for the member, or not-applicable when the verifier does not answer the suite, or error when the member could not be read.

reason.description: The first failing rule's code, or the error text.

result.description: The verifier's full result object for the member, when it has one.
